analyst_note: Seven distinct filings spanning November 2025 through May 2026 consistently guided topline data readout for the LUCIDITY Phase 3 avexitide trial in Q3 2026 (July-September), while ClinicalTrials.gov has maintained a stable primary completion date of March 2026 since initial registration in December 2024 with zero slippage. This 4-6 month systematic divergence between public guidance and the unchanged registry—across multiple quarters and communications—suggests the company may have internal knowledge of trial delays or data issues not reflected in formal disclosures. While the findings are individually graded minor (timeline inconsistency alone), the persistent pattern across seven independent marketing events for this specific catalyst trial constitutes a moderate operational masking signal warranting elevated caution.
